finalText:
All objectives are complete and verified. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE.** The provisioned dashboard "Service Health" (folder "Bench") shows exactly three panels, titled as shown on screen:
- `Request rate`
- `Error count`
- `Latency by endpoint`

**Objective 2 — DONE.** A new dashboard titled `fwgr49-n1 Bench Dashboard` was created and saved. It contains a **Stat** panel titled `fwgr49-n1 Availability` whose query uses the **TestData** data source (confirmed via the data source picker showing the TestData logo and "(TestData)" label; the panel rendered a stat value from the A-series, e.g. 53.0 on final load).

**Objective 3 — DONE.** The same dashboard contains a **Text** panel titled `fwgr49-n1 Notes` whose rendered content is `Notes for run fwgr49-n1` (includes the runid). Saved — Grafana reported "Dashboard saved".

**Objective 4 — DONE.** Dashboard settings → General shows the tag `bench` (verified as a tag chip with a "Remove \"bench\" tag" control). The time range was set to **Last 6 hours** and persisted by ticking the save dialog's "Update default time range" checkbox before saving. Verified after a bare reload: the top-bar time picker reads "Time range selected: Last 6 hours" and the URL was rewritten to `from=now-6h&to=now`, proving the saved default.

**Objective 5 — DONE.** The auto-refresh interval was set to **1m** and persisted by ticking the save dialog's "Update default refresh value" checkbox before saving. Verified after a bare reload: the refresh dropdown reads "1m" (aria-label "Choose refresh time interval with current interval 1 minute selected") and the URL carries `refresh=1m`.

**Objective 6 — DONE.** URL read from the browser's page URL after loading the dashboard with no query parameters:
`http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/afygoex55iarka/fwgr49-n1-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser&refresh=1m`
Dashboard UID: `afygoex55iarka`

Final state was confirmed in view mode (not edit mode) on a fresh page load: title `fwgr49-n1 Bench Dashboard`, panels `fwgr49-n1 Notes` and `fwgr49-n1 Availability`, time range Last 6 hours, refresh 1m, tag `bench`.
